scores.tell: Duck body, wings and red saddle are uniformly lacquered plastic with big soft highlights; spring and bolts are glossy but fine. Little matte contrast.
Whole bottle is one wet glossy plastic. Even sheen and scattered droplets with strong white highlights. Cap ridges are chunky.
Matte soft plastic body with a small glossy screen and keys. Gloss range and surface smoothness match the real towel and saddle cards. Almost none.
Barrel has large decorative wood grain streaks and a painterly texture, plus an orange splotch. Hoops are glossy dark metal. Matches the too-texture-y lesson.
Glossy orange wood hull and shiny gold portholes read as lacquered. Sails are smooth and painterly, and the water has foam blobs. Little fine material detail.
Matte rubbery sandal with a regular dot pattern and satin straps. Dots are a bit uniform and chunky.
Wagon shows smooth cartoon wood with painted grain and a flat canvas. It is painterly with a soft glaze, and the fine seams and rivets are lost. Close to the grade 2 wagon.
Matte plastic clock with soft sheen on the orange rim and a clean white face. Rim is slightly glossy and the surface is very smooth.
Whole locker is uniformly glossy orange enamel. The floor wood grain is fine. Books, shoes and ball have some fabric and leather variety, but the metal hinges are small.
Rocket body is glossy chrome-like silver with strong specular highlights on the red nose and fins. Glossier and more lacquered than the reference cards. Rivets are tiny.
